verdict.rationale: Pika's own site says it can score any clip to picture with music, ambience and foley matched to the action. It also lists dedicated text-to-SFX and music generation apps inside the same platform that combines video, image and sound creation. The evidence is limited to brief first-party marketing lines. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of how scene matching works (controls, sync, mixing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a creator, I can add generated sound effects, ambient audio, or music matched to the scene in the same tool

citations.quote: Scores any clip to picture—music, ambience and foley matched to the action.
